goals.title: Survey
goals.objective: Survey 2025-2026 community sources (Reddit, HN, X, blogs, GitHub) for popular leftover-token use patterns for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex
goals.evidence: Survey gathered 25+ sources across Claude Code docs, Codex docs, blogs, Medium, dev.to, GitHub, and OpenAI/Anthropic help centers covering: Ralph loop overnight execution, Claude Code Routines (cloud schedule), sub-agents / agent teams parallel work, security audits (/security-review, /secret-scanner, /deps-check), dependency upgrades, test coverage generation (30%->85% in 20min), refactoring legacy code (800-line files in 15min), codebase onboarding skills (CLAUDE.md generation), Karpathy-style LLM Wiki / Obsidian second brain, Codex /goal mode for long autonomous tasks, Codex Automations scheduled tasks, MCP+Agents-SDK orchestration, and coding-tutor skills. Strong signals for clustering into 10 categories.

goals.title: Synthesize
goals.objective: Cluster and rank the top 10 methods with pros/cons, target user, and required setup
goals.evidence: Top 10 ranked methods clustered with target user / setup / pros / cons / recipe each, plus honorable mentions and anti-patterns. Draft synthesized into research/leftover-tokens-top10.md.
